speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The letter is where you left it. I have not folded it, and I have not asked it the day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. There is no day in it. It is not going.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is under the cloth. I did not put it to the notch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And you will not. Monday is soon enough to tell a penny loaf it is short. I know the answer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the notch stays shut. I am not measuring a loaf I already know.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can set the board without a measure. The loaf can stay behind the cloth.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Dinner is on the board. The sheet on the nail is not a guest. Sit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sitting. The sheet can keep its nail.
